answer: Require each agent to hold a latency fingerprint: repeated round-trip timings from one stable location, like a lone mesa rising above flat desert, form a profile no farm can mass-produce, since its identities share one datacenter clock. A velvet-smooth honest agent builds its profile once and keeps working; a vault of fake identities collapses when their timings cluster identically. Recheck fingerprints at random and drop identities whose profiles merge.
